edges.method: pin.1 of b1 in pin-hole.1 of b16
pin.1 of b3 in pin-hole.2 of b16
pin.2 of b1 in pin-hole.1 of b21
pin.2 of b3 in pin-hole.2 of b21
clip.1 of b27 clipped on side handle (clip.1) of b26
propeller axle-hole.1 on wheel holder axle-hole.1
propeller hub axle-hole.1 on top pin.1

notes: Piece count is 46, matching the parts list.

This is a single model. All sub-assemblies are connected: the floats by pins into the 30157 plates, the clip plate by its clip on the 48336 handle, the tail propeller by its axle in the 4488 wheel holder, and the rotor by its hub on the 2460 top pin. The connectivity warning came from my earlier other_joins using 'b1:pin.1'-style endpoints. They now use plain piece ids, with the ports named in `method`.

The booklet images are small, so some rests_on relations and placements are best guesses. This applies mainly to the 2x4 and 2x3 plate base (steps 2-5), the slope stack in step 11, and the tail and rotor.
The two 30157 plates are assumed to form a 4x4 base. The 3021 plate bridges them, and the two white 3020 plates sit on top.
Each yellow float is built from 17485, two 4032a, a 30361c and a 30367c. It is held to the base by pins from the two 30157 plates fitting its pin holes.
Step 10: the 60470b is clipped onto the 48336 side handle, and the two trans-yellow round tiles sit on its studs.
The tail is built from 3460, 4488 and 44661, with the 2421 propeller in the 4488 wheel holder. It sits on the two trans-dark-blue plates from step 12.
The two 6636 tiles are recorded as resting on the 2479 rotor. The minifigure is not in the parts list and is omitted.
